[[Category:Court of law]]
A '''court of law''' is a part of a [[justice system]] responsible for<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>

* Receiving requests ('''cases''') from [[legal entities]]
* Assess whether it has [[jurisdiction]] over the case
* If so, follow '''legal procedure''' to arrive at a decision based on relevant law ('''judgement''')
** For many cases, the legal procedure requires a [[trial]]
